A business metric is any structured measurement you track over time—monthly website traffic, feature adoption rate, headcount. A KPI is the subset tied directly to a strategic objective, with a target, a timeline, and an expectation that someone acts when it moves. In practice, the difference looks like this: tracking that web traffic increased 15% this quarter is a metric. Measuring whether web traffic is on track to increase 20% by Q4 to generate 500 qualified leads is a KPI—same number, but with a goal and a deadline attached.

not an AI-first SOC 2 engine.

the enterprise suite many organizations standardize on for privacy, consent, and third-party risk. 
If your compliance program starts with GDPR operations, DSARs, cookie consent, and privacy 
governance, and you want adjacent modules for tech risk, AI governance, and TPRM in the same 
ecosystem, OneTrust is built for that kind of consolidation.

 feature adoption rate, headcount. A KPI is the subset tied directly to a strategic objective, with 
 a target, a timeline, and an expectation that someone acts when it moves. In practice, the         
 difference looks like this: tracking that web traffic increased 15% this quarter is a metric.      
 Measuring whether web traffic is on track to increase 20% by Q4 to generate 500 qualified leads is 
 a KPI—same number, but with a goal and a deadline attached.
